name: Progress-24
about: Progress-24 (1985-051A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1985 Jun 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Jun 28), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
